impact: The fade in SoftBank and Korean chipmakers tempers the memory rebound for MU, DRAM and SNXX after Tuesday's spike; steady US futures suggest CoreWeave's results are offsetting some of the CPI and Nvidia pressure on NBIS.
summary: Kospi opened up 0.26% at 5,252.51 and the Nikkei 225 slipped 0.1% to 60,396.15 on Wednesday after the hotter-than-expected US CPI, following Tuesday's 4.4% and 2.9% rallies. SoftBank fell 9.17% to 3,517 yen, giving back part of its 13.9% jump, and Samsung and SK Hynix opened lower. US futures were slightly higher overnight, with S&P 500 futures up 0.2% and Nasdaq-100 futures up 0.4% after CoreWeave's beat.
title: Asia opens flat after hot US CPI; SoftBank sinks 9%
